description: Dataset of "A Two-Stage Wide Area Protection Scheme with a Single Terminal Transmission Line Observation is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Matěj Vrtal, Karel Bouzek (Brno University of Technology). Transmission lines are the backbone of any power grid, responsible for delivering generated power to consumers. They are typically protected by local protection systems that may fail under stressed operational conditions, leading to cascading failures. This paper introduces a two-stage wide-area protection scheme (WAPS) to offer more secure and reliable protection functions. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
